en.p: There are an ellipse $\dfrac{x^{2}}{9}+\dfrac{y^{2}}{5}=1$ with one focus $\mathrm{F}(c,\,0)\ (c>0)$ and a circle with center $(2,\,3)$ and radius $r$. For a point $\mathrm{P}$ on the ellipse and a point $\mathrm{Q}$ on the circle, when the minimum value of $\overline{\mathrm{PQ}}-\overline{\mathrm{PF}}$ is $6$, find the value of $r$. [4 points]
